name: B10-0226/2025 (ECR) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Iran to cancel the death sentences of Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani, two activists it says were tortured and given unfair, politically motivated trials. It also urges Iran to stop all executions, release people held for their religion or for defending human rights, and end its repression of women, minorities and dissidents. Finally, it asks the Council of the European Union to label the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps a terrorist organisation and to sanction everyone responsible for human rights abuses. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes directly: the Parliament is only stating demands and opinions.
- It concerns Iran's government, death-row prisoners and Iran's women, minorities and dissidents.
- Next, the text goes to Iran's Parliament and Government; the Council is asked to act on sanctions.
